question.text: If an investment of Rs.1,000 per month earns 15% per annum for 35 years, the approximate corpus accumulated would be:

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Series XVII pp.21-22, Rs.1,000 per month invested for 35 years at 15% per annum gives Rs.1,46,77,180. FV(15%/12, 420, -1000, 0, 0) confirms this figure. The Trap: Rs.4,20,000 is just the simple sum of contributions (Rs.1,000 x 420 months). Many underestimate the power of compounding over long periods. Note: The Rs.1,46,77,180 corpus figure and the Rs.4,20,000 simple-contribution total are taken directly from the Series XVII workbook pp.21-22 illustration.
